question: According to CRISIL’s Infrastructure Yearbook 2023, what is the total projected infrastructure spending in India over the next seven years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹143 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to CRISIL’s Infrastructure Yearbook 2023, the projected infrastructure spending in India over the next seven years is estimated at **₹143 lakh crore**.
 
• This spending is aligned with the government's focus on achieving its **‘Vision 2047’**, aimed at transforming India into a developed nation by the 100th year of independence.
